## overview

A local-first personal strategy engine. It ranks everything I could be doing by leverage against my own goals, fits the best of it into my real day with sleep, meals, training and people protected, and compares that plan with what I'd otherwise do. Daily and weekly reviews feed back in, recalibrating time estimates and flagging when one goal is eating more than its share of the week. No accounts or API keys, and all data stays in the browser.

## details

  • An eight-factor weighted leverage score, with a plain-language explanation for every ranking.
  • A scheduler that works around routine, commitments and travel, matches tasks to energy and focus windows, and stops before eating into requested open time.
  • Important tasks that don't fit come back with concrete fixes: postpone something lower-ranked, shorten, split or move to tomorrow.
  • After three completed tasks per goal, actual-vs-estimate ratios recalibrate future durations.
  • 55 unit tests cover the scoring, scheduling, comparison and review engine.
